data.name: Divya
data.gender_notes: Divya is used as a female name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit divya, 'divine, heavenly', from the root div, 'to shine'. Its root is Sanskrit divya (दिव्य). A classical Sanskrit term for the divine. Divya is a Sanskrit name meaning “Divine; heavenly; brilliant”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Divya expresses “Divine; heavenly; brilliant”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit divya, 'divine, heavenly', from the root div, 'to shine'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Divya total 25, reducing to 7. Number 7 is associated with reflection, analysis and inner search.
